name: AECi — p95 detail page render > 1.5s (10m)
message:
p95 server render time for detail pages on a cache MISS has exceeded 1.5s (sustained 10m). Scoped to cache_status:miss because HITs are served from the edge and would mask slow real renders.

Likely causes: slow API query (check p95 aeci.api.query.duration_ms by endpoint), Supabase latency, or an Angular SSR regression.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#high-p95-detail-render
